codes.meaning: The cooktop is running in demo/display mode, so the cooking zones will not actually heat up.
The cooktop can't reach the home Wi-Fi network or pair with the range hood over the network.
The battery inside the wireless cooking sensor accessory is nearly dead.
The electrical supply reaching the unit is outside the voltage range the cooktop expects.
A cooking zone got too hot and shut itself off automatically to protect the countertop surface.
The internal electronics overheated, causing the affected cooking zone to power down until it cools.
Hard-water scale has built up inside the heat pump component and needs descaling.
A safety float switch has sensed water pooling in the bottom of the tub.
The machine is having trouble getting water to flow in properly during the fill stage.
Water isn't filling to the right level, or the pump isn't circulating water correctly.
The drain pump is obstructed, clogged, or has failed outright.
The household electrical supply voltage reaching the dishwasher is lower than what it needs.

oven.note: Thermador's oven support page documents mainly a generic 'E + number = fault code' pattern plus these three specific firmware-update codes, rather than a broad fault-code table.

codes.meaning: A Home Connect firmware update failed or stalled at this specific stage of the process.
A Home Connect firmware update encountered a different failure point during the update sequence.
A Home Connect firmware update hit yet another distinct checkpoint failure during installation.
The range's induction cooktop section is in demo mode, so the burners won't actually produce heat.
The range's cooktop can't connect to the home Wi-Fi network or the venting hood.
The power supply voltage feeding the unit falls outside the expected safe range.
One of the induction cooking zones overheated and shut off to protect the cooktop surface.
The electronics controlling a cooking zone overheated, so that zone was disabled until it cools.
A cooking zone has been left running continuously for so long that the automatic shutoff timer kicked in.
